description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) FOR THE EMPEROR! (Tacticus Firestorm Force, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). "Command phase" (either player's): in the ORK player's Command phase, real clicks on the phase action button and 'End Command Phase' open the active player's windows (declined, not under test) and then the new command_phase_opponent window for the Space Marines player; a real click spends 1 CP; the Assault Intercessors have +1 OC during the opponent's turn.
